desktop.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production background art for a notebook football squad formation board. Create only the field drawing, a clean standalone raster game asset, NOT a UI mockup. Reference image shows the desired blue ballpoint strokes and paper character; use its football-field appearance only, remove all interface elements, player names, O symbols, team logo, arrows, and team-name lettering.
Wide landscape canvas about 1.8:1. Top-down flat orthographic scan of a football field casually sketched by a teenager in blue ballpoint. Dark navy ink #243e78. Nearly full-bleed rectangular field boundary from 2% to 98% across and 2% to 98% down. Retraced slightly wobbly thin boundary; dry broken ink and subtle scratched parallel pen lines, little pressure changes, imperfect corners. Horizontal yard lines near 14%, 35%, 56%, and 77% of image height; two interior columns of tiny hash marks at 35% and 65% across. Small casually written 30, 20, 10 numerals at left and right sidelines by the first three respective yard lines. A full-width shallow endzone occupies the bottom 13% from y85% to y98%, outlined twice with generous loose diagonal ballpoint hatching at both corners and a very faint hatched wash elsewhere. LEAVE ENDZONE CENTER BLANK for a live team name to be overlaid. Keep field center mostly open transparent negative space for five interactive player Os and names.
Genuinely transparent background alpha, visible only actual blue pen strokes. NO white or cream rectangular fill, NO paper texture, NO ruled notebook lines, no grass, no shadows, no perspective, no photo of a physical notebook. This asset will be laid over the existing warm ruled notebook paper in the webpage. Do not include any players, circles, Xs, routes, arrows, text other than the sideline numbers 30 20 10, logos, title, names or extra elements. Natural drawn linework, no rigid perfect vector geometry, no glossy stadium. Consistency with reference, richer scratch texture, readable when shown about 800px wide.

mobile.prompt: Create a square 1:1 responsive companion asset from this generated football field. Preserve exactly the same indigo ballpoint pen quality, transparent alpha background, imperfect outlines, little sideline tick marks, two inner hash-mark columns, and sideline numbers 30 / 20 / 10. Recompose the field for a square canvas, do not merely compress the drawing: numbers should retain natural readable proportions and line weight. Boundary at 2% and 98% edges; yard lines near y16%, y36%, y56%; endzone top at y78% and bottom y97%. Keep the open center blank for live players. Lower endzone has loose scratch hatching with center blank for a live team name. Genuine transparent background; NO white/cream fill, paper, checkerboard, players, Os, Xs, route arrows, names, or team lettering. This is a standalone production field background, not a screenshot.
